title: Open-Meteo ERA5 archive — June 2016–2025, Sierre (46.2923 N, 7.5323 E)
claims: Open-Meteo ERA5 archive for the grid cell at 46.2923 N, 7.5323 E, elevation 533 m, over the 300 June days from 2016 to 2025: mean daily maximum 25.0 °C and mean daily minimum 14.3 °C.
The same query gives mean precipitation of 3.2 mm per day; 152 of the 300 June days (50.7%) had at least 1 mm.
These are reanalysis statistics for a grid cell at Sierre, not official race data and not measurements from Zinal or the course high point.

verification.note: 2026-11-08 直接查询 Open-Meteo archive API，取 2016–2025 年 6 月共 300 天，按 daily time 过滤 06 月后计算均值；坐标与海拔采用 Sierre 镇中心，不代表 Zinal 或 Weisshorn 高海拔。

claimVerification.note: API 返回 300 个 6 月日值；temperature_2m_max 均值 25.0，temperature_2m_min 均值 14.3。
precipitation_sum 均值 3.2 mm/day；≥1 mm 的日数 152/300 = 50.7%。
Sierre 与 Zinal 海拔差约 1,100 m；本页明确不把 Sierre 数据外推到终点或山口。
